name: Sofia Vargas
bio:
Sofia's passion for motorsport ignited during her childhood in Bogotá, where she spent countless hours tinkering with her father's vintage motorcycle. This hands-on experience fueled her desire to pursue a career in engineering. After graduating with honors from the Universidad Nacional de Colombia, Sofia sought opportunities to combine her mechanical expertise with her love for racing.

Her journey led her to Europe, where she honed her skills working for various motorsport teams before securing a position with Stake Sauber. Sofia is known for her meticulous approach to precision machining and her unwavering commitment to quality. She believes that even the smallest component can make a significant difference on the track, and she strives to optimize every part to its fullest potential. Sofia's innovative solutions and collaborative spirit make her a valuable asset to the team, constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible. 

What sets Sofia apart is her ability to visualize complex mechanical systems in her mind, allowing her to quickly identify potential issues and develop creative solutions. Her deep understanding of materials science and manufacturing processes enables her to push the limits of performance while maintaining the highest standards of safety and reliability. Her dedication is fueled by the dream of seeing a Colombian driver win the World Championship using a car she helped build.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a high ponytail to keep it out of her face while working.
physical.description: Sofia is of average height with a lean, athletic build from years of cycling.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and design ideas.
Has a habit of humming quietly while concentrating on intricate machining tasks.
Insists on calibrating her tools before each shift, even if they were already calibrated the day before.
